items.title: Hull KR vs Warrington LIVE! Build-up to tonight's Super League game
Former world snooker champion Dott in court accused of child sex abuse
items.description: Former world snooker champion Graeme Dott has gone on trial accused of historical child sex abuse.

items.title: Rodri ready for 'excitement again' after Barca complete £65m deal
items.description: Barcelona sign Spain midfielder Rodri, the player of the 2026 World Cup, from Manchester City after a trophy-laden seven years with the Premier League club.

items.title: Venus Williams given US Open wild card - with another held potentially for Serena
items.description: Venus Williams has been given a wild card into the US Open singles draw, and the tournament is keeping one on hold - perhaps in case her sister Serena wants to join her.

items.title: Aston Villa agree deal for West Ham's Wan-Bissaka
items.description: Aston Villa agree to sign West Ham defender Aaron Wan-Bissaka on an initial loan deal with an obligation to buy at the end of the season.

items.title: Fifa sacking 'deeply troubling' - Uefa executive
items.description: Fifa's decision to dismiss senior executive Kevin Lamour following his criticism of president Gianni Infantino sends a "deeply troubling message to all of us seeking change", says UEFA vice-president Laura McAllister.

items.title: Root won't 'rip up' Bazball blueprint as Babar is ruled out for Pakistan
items.description: Returning England Test skipper Joe Root says he feels "as ready as any other England captain", adding he has no plans on "ripping up" the Bazball blueprint that preceded his second stint in charge.

items.title: Maguire: I want to be greedy about winning trophies
items.description: Sitting down with Harry Maguire for one of his first interviews of the season, I found a player who was reflective but also excited about the future and what's to come.

items.title: Hollie Doyle blog: Constitution River can come of age in Juddmonte International showdown with Ombudsman
items.description: Sky Sports Racing ambassador Hollie Doyle runs the rule on day one of York's Ebor Festival on Wednesday, featuring the eagerly awaited clash between Ombudsman and Constitution River.

items.title: PL chief Masters: Man City charges verdict 'has taken longer than expected'
items.description: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters says a verdict on the alleged charges against Manchester City "has taken longer than expected".

items.title: Celtic out to erase Kairat pain as O'Neill eyes Champions League return
items.description: Twelve months ago, Celtic's humiliating Champions League exit to Kairat Almaty set the tone for a campaign of chaos. Martin O'Neill is determined to erase that pain.

items.title: Premier League chief Masters says Fifa self-destructed over World Cup plan
items.description: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has criticised Fifa president Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan, saying the organisation has "pressed the self-destruct button" by delivering "a self-inflicted wound".
